Vendored from node-unrar-js@2.0.2 (https://github.com/YuJianrong/node-unrar.js),
files esm/js/unrar.js, esm/js/unrar.wasm and esm/js/Extractor.js, unmodified
except for removing the source map comment. MIT, see LICENSE.md.

unrar.wasm is RARLAB's UnRAR source compiled with Emscripten. The UnRAR
license allows using it to extract RAR archives; it may not be used to
create RAR-compatible archivers.
